author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the Announcement Trailer for DOOBAK, a 1-4 player co-op digging adventure developed by SILLY CROW. The village is buried under snow. Everyone else has already left, and you slept through it. Now you and your friends have to escape the frozen trap: dig tunnels, search for useful items, warm up by campfires, and try to signal rescuers before the blizzard swallows the village for good. DOOBAK is coming soon to PC (Steam) https://store.steampowered.com/app/4425090/DOOBAK/?utm_source=youtube&utm_content=gametrailers_trailer
title: DOOBAK - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Step into a cel-shaded world and check out gameplay from Tin Coffins, an upcoming third-person mech roguelite shooter game. Tin Coffins will be available on PC in December 2026. A demo is out now on Steam.

In Tin Coffins, players take on the role of Talon-22, a combat clone freshly printed and sent into a war that has already claimed twenty-one previous versions of them. Piloting a four-meter armored mech, players fight through devastated cities, lead their squad against enemy forces, and attempt to survive missions where a single tactical mistake can mean death. When a pilot falls, the war continues, and the next clone takes their place.
title: Tin Coffins - Official Demo Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Get a look at the Treasure Hunters One Piece Hybrid Trailer for Fortnite, the hit third-person action battle royale shooter developed by Epic Games. Players can check out an animated trailer centered on the hit One Piece anime, as skins based on the beloved IP arrive in the game in search of that sweet, sweet treasure and Victory Royale alike. The Treasure Hunters Season in Fortnite is available now.
title: Fortnite x One Piece - Official We Are! Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Meet Gratia and learn about this character in this new Silver Palace trailer for this upcoming open-world detective action RPG. Silver Palace will be available on PC, Android, iOS, and PlayStation 5 (PS5) on December 14, 2026.

Inspired by Victorian aesthetics, Silver Palace brings to life a bustling metropolis powered by a mysterious substance known as "Silverium." As industrial civilization advances at an unprecedented pace, rival factions compete for control of this valuable resource. Beneath the city's glittering facade lies a web of intricate conspiracies and long-buried secrets. Players will take on the role of a detective, joining forces with a diverse cast of companions to investigate cases, follow clues, and gradually uncover the truth behind the city.
title: Silver Palace - Official Gratia Character and Release Date Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Mayday: The Survival Island, a handcrafted pixel-art survival game from Pequi Studios, has just launched on Steam. Stranded after a mysterious crash, you'll hunt, fish, farm, and craft your way across 24 hand-drawn islands, turning a first-night shelter into a full homestead while uncovering what was on the archipelago long before you arrived.

#IGN
title: Mayday: The Survival Island - Official Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the Release Date Trailer for Frostpunk 2: The Surge, an upcoming DLC for the hit survival strategy game developed by 11 Bit Studios. Players will take on an unknown valley where a new resource can change the course of history forever. Embark on a whole new story in Frostpunk 2: The Surge, launching on December 14 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam and Epic Games Store).
title: Frostpunk 2: The Surge - Official Release Date Trailer

description: Here's a look at the Barcelona DLC Launch Trailer for Session: Skate Sim, a skateboarding simulation game developed by Crea-ture Studios. Players will take to the bustling streets of Barcelona to pull off tricks and seek out new spots across the city. Take to Barcelona in the Barcelona DLC for Session: Skate Sim, available now for PlayStation 4 (PS4), PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam, Epic Games Store, and Xbox Cloud).
title: Session: Skate Sim - Official Barcelona DLC Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Get a look at the Early Access Launch Trailer for Gravhounds, a co-op third-person action shooter developed by Octopus Panic. Players will fight on the front lines to defend their base from certain doom and earn rewards in the process. Fend off waves of enemies in Gravhounds, available now in Early Access for Xbox Series X|S, Xbox Game Pass, and PC (Xbox on PC and Steam).
title: Gravhounds - Official Early Access Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Watch the Marvel Contest of Champions Victors and Variance: Empire of Doom Saga (Part 1 of 2) motion comic trailer for a peek at what's coming to the fighting game. The Empire of Doom Saga will bring new quests, events, and more. The new motion comic trailer features the voice of Matthew Mercer. An epic battle for the fate of The Battlerealm is about to begin! Marvel Contest of Champions is available on mobile and PC.
title: Marvel Contest of Champions - Official Victors and Variance: Empire of Doom Saga (Part 1) Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Enjoy a creepy song from Spooky Tales in this new trailer for the upcoming game that draws inspiration from anthology horror such as Tales from The Crypt, Goosebumps, Are You Afraid of The Dark?, and more. Spooky Tales blends narrative exploration with interactive minigames. The anthology collection spans 1920s pulp dread, Japanese body horror, found footage, and classic slashers. A charismatic undead host guides players through stories of sinister coastal waters, a new student with dark secrets, a desperate TV crew, and a pizza party turned bloody. Spooky Tales is coming soon to PC via Steam.
title: Spooky Tales - Official Trailer | Top Hat Fall Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description:
Here's your look at the trailer for Prima Materia, an upcoming dark, surreal visual novel from developer Radi Art (creator of Synergia). Prima Materia is set in a sterilized wasteland ruled by Angels, where consciousness is harvested, brewed, and sold. Mana, a Mind Digger who survives by eating minds, takes one last job: fixing a demi-angel worth keeping whole. 

Prima Materia will be available on PC in 2027.
title: Prima Materia - Official Announcement Trailer | Top Hat Fall Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Step into the unsettling world of Metamorphosis in this trailer for the upcoming adventure game. A forsaken nun’s long road to absolution unfolds in Metamorphosis, a haunting adventure set in a long-dead world. Branded a sinner, Aria must traverse towering megastructures, fight demons, and journey toward the last paradise. Guide her through sprawling, interconnected ruins, solve challenging puzzles, and manage dwindling resources while wielding firearms and powerful miracles in deliberate, high-risk combat.
title: Metamorphosis - Official Trailer | Top Hat Fall Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at gameplay from My Ransomware Can't Be This Cute?!, an upcoming kawaii, neon card-flipping, iterative roguelike where the stakes are always high. With your computer held hostage by a cute-but-devious computer virus, you must deduce where evil cards are hiding or trust your instincts and go for a potentially million-dollar card. This tense card-flipping deckbuilding roguelike challenges you to balance logical deduction with a willingness to push your luck. My Ransomware Can't Be This Cute?! will be available on PC via Steam in 2027.
title: My Ransomware Can't Be This Cute?! - Official Gameplay Trailer | Top Hat Fall Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Here's your look at the announcement trailer for RGB: Execution, an upcoming fast-paced 2D pixel action-meets-bullet hell set in a post-apocalyptic future where Generative AI has taken over a dead world. Each boss is its own puzzle to solve, challenging players to adapt their approach through a blend of action, bullet hell, and problem-solving. RGB: Execution will be available on PC via Steam.
title: RGB: Execution - Official Announcement Trailer | Top Hat Fall Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description:
Get another look at combat and the strange setting of The Backworld in this latest trailer for the upcoming RPG. The Backworld will be available on PC via Steam in Q2 2027.

The Backworld invites players to slip between the cracks of reality into a surreal, world-bending RPG where danger awaits at every turn. Survival demands strategy, as players must decide when to fight and when to flee. As they explore interconnected worlds, they collect strange items, unlock new abilities, and recruit unique companions, forging their own path through a cosmic horror story where every choice matters.
title: The Backworld - Official Release Window Trailer | Top Hat Fall Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Console Release Window Trailer for Ova Magica, a life creature-collecting simulation game developed by SkinnyFrog. Players will oversee a farm in the serene Clover Town to make friends, raise blob companions, and explore vibrant locations. Ova Magica is launching in November 2026 for PlayStation, Xbox, Nintendo Switch, and Nintendo Switch 2.
title: Ova Magica - Official Console Release Window Trailer | Top Hat Fall Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Take another look at Delivery Must Complete in this new trailer for the upcoming roguelike action game from developer Yoyollie. High-speed dogfights and daring deliveries await in Delivery Must Complete. You can fly, fight, and upgrade a roster of kickass planes through cel-shaded, arcade-paced aerial combat across procedurally generated maps. From aircrafts and blimps to dragons and mechs, every battle is massive, and every fight is a spectacle. Delivery Must Complete will be available on PC via Steam, with other platforms to be announced. A demo will be available in early 2027.
title: Delivery Must Complete - Official Demo Release Date Trailer | Top Hat Fall Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Watch the Reveal Trailer for Ryn and the Thread of Life, a 3D hack-and-slash action game developed by Innombrable. Players will navigate a world with an anime-meets-cartoon vibe to take on the five wicked dolls. Take their power and restore the Thread of Life in Ryn and the Thread of Life, coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: Ryn and the Thread of Life - Official Reveal Trailer | Top Hat Fall Showcase 2026

Stellar Blade is launching on November 5 for Nintendo Switch 2, with the game available now for PlayStation 5 (PS5) and PC (Steam).

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at gameplay and more from Estella in this trailer for the upcoming 3D rhythm game set in deep space. In Estella, you race across octagonal lanes with a mouse and keyboard. Each planet is told as one chapter, and a deep story unfolds that blends cinematic presentation with rhythm gameplay. Estella will be available in Early Access on PC (via Steam) this winter. An updated demo is out now on Steam.
title: Estella - Official Trailer

description:
